description:
What testing a data location for hardlinks found.

Tested on the location itself where it exists, and otherwise on the deepest parent
that does, which is named so that a result read off a parent is never shown as the
location's own.

oneOf.description: It hardlinks, so imports are instant and cost no extra disk.

inferred_from.description: The parent the test ran on, where the location did not exist yet.

oneOf.description: It works but cannot hardlink, so every import is a copy.

limitation.description: The filesystem's reason, where it has one that can be named.

oneOf.description: It could not be tested, with the platform's words for why.

reason.description: Why the test could not run.
